label: An actual G-ground gives its grounded being being wherever that being exists
paraphrase: OPEN bridge (b), analyst formulation, unattributed: whatever is an actual concrete ground of x at w in the selected grounding relation G (in the profile on the frame's existence) gives x being (GivesTo) at w if x exists there, and at every world accessible from w where x exists. The only premise of this batch that joins G-grounding to giving (rigor contract 5 of #1926; #1626). It carries two components: grounding read as productive dependence for being (the sustaining cause-of-being sense of 88a8fba7), and rigidity of the actual ground's giving across accessible worlds where the grounded being exists. Classical theism (conservation) and Avicenna's emanation both accept it; it fails if G is read as non-productive dependence.
